item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the photo, because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. No image was created.

I tried two ways:
1. **AI Headshot tool** (50 credits): refused for insufficient credits.
2. **Image editor with flux-2-klein at 640px** (about 5 credits, the cheapest option on the free plan): also refused for insufficient credits.

Even the cheapest edit was refused, so the balance is probably close to zero. To go ahead, you could:
- **Wait for your free credits to refresh**, or
- **Buy a credit pack or upgrade your plan** on Magic Hour.

Once you have credits, I'll run it again. The plan is to keep your face, gray hair and expression the same, put you in a navy suit jacket with a white shirt and tie, and replace the kitchen with a clean, softly blurred gray studio background with soft studio lighting. If you'd like a different look, like an open collar, a light office background or a different color suit, tell me and I'll change the instructions.
